description: RbNa₂BO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmmn space group. Rb is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Rb-O bond lengths are 2.90 Å. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.49 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.39 Å) and two longer (1.41 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, two equivalent Na, and one B atom.
